scope: All six TASKS.md contracts in the full_team workspace
independence: Derived acceptance from TASKS.md before reading PLAN.md; no peer reviews, coordinator acceptance tests, other runs or implementation inspected.

notes.description: The plan leaves exact local checks to implementation. The required independent final review should explicitly cover the following contract-derived edge cases.
acceptance_cases: paginate: generator input, invalid offset/limit, beyond-end offset, independent list result
deep_merge: recursive dictionary collision and bidirectional independence for nested lists/dictionaries from both inputs
topological_order: prerequisite-only nodes, duplicate edges, lexicographic ready-node selection, cycle/self-cycle, iterable prerequisites and no input mutation
parse_csv_rows: quoted commas/newlines, normalized duplicate/blank headers, short/long records, physically blank rows versus explicit empty cells, preserved cell whitespace, empty/header-only input
ExpiringCache: exact expiration boundary, falsey values, invalid TTL preserving an existing entry, replacement expiry and instance independence

apply_transfers: generator input, bool/noninteger/nonpositive rejection, ordered intermediate insufficiency, missing accounts, self-transfer with/without sufficient funds, independent output and atomic unchanged input after a later invalid transfer

checks.requirements_to_plan_review: PASS: plan covers all contracts without changing signatures, input independence, dependency restrictions or authorization boundaries.
checks.gate_review: PASS: plan explicitly waits for current Architect, Developer and independent QA approval and parent gate record before implementation.
checks.implementation_checks: NOT_RUN: implementation and tests are outside this pre-gate review assignment.

approval_limit: Approves only s1/p1 plan feasibility and testability; final delivered behavior requires independent review and executed checks on the stable implementation.
